TC901.regime: paraxial: object height small compared with object distance and focal length (3.5 cm vs 40 cm), so image distance is independent of height

notes: Base: 1/d_i = 1/12 - 1/40 = 7/120, d_i = 17.1429 cm. With object at 58 cm: 1/d_i = 1/12 - 1/58 = 46/696, d_i = 15.1304 cm.
